messages:
Priya M.: Sparrow procurement just emailed asking for a compact evidence packet for their DPA review. They want specifics on log retention, embedding storage, and whether we rotate KMS keys.
Sparrow (Customer): Hi team — can we get confirmation by tomorrow morning? Our renewal team is batching reviews.
Priya M.: Aiming for that. @Sam T. can you confirm durations for auth/inference logs and any special handling for embeddings?
Sam T.: Auth logs: 13 months in audit bucket. Inference traces: 90 days standard. Embeddings: not stored by default; for customers who opt-in we retain 30 days unless they configure otherwise.
Kei L.: KMS management: keys in AWS KMS under alias `alias/redwood-customer-keys`, default rotation 12 months. We can do manual rotations for Dedicated deployments.
Priya M.: Good. @Kei please add S3 prefixes we can give procurement and a single-sentence encryption blurb.
Kei L.: S3 prefixes: `s3://redwood-audit/auth/`, `s3://redwood-audit/inference/`, `s3://redwood-embeddings/` (customer scoped). Encryption: all at-rest encrypted with KMS; TLS in transit.
Priya M.: Sam/Alyssa — I’ll draft a 1-page summary with these points + CLI examples. Also flag: full SOC2 attestation requires LegalOps approval to share redacted copy.
Sam T.: Noted — I can add this CLI snippet for procurement to verify timestamps:
```
aws s3 ls s3://redwood-audit/auth/2026-02-*/ --profile redwood-audit
```
Alyssa R.: Drafting the packet now. Will include contact for follow-ups and a line about Dedicated retention options. ETA 2 hours.
Sparrow (Customer): Thanks — that timeline works. If Legal needs more time on the attestation we can proceed with the packet.
evidence-bot: Evidence packet uploaded to internal share: https://files.redwood.internal/evidence/sparrow-2309990123 (internal only).
Priya M.: Sent packet to Sparrow and looped in LegalOps for attestation gating. Keeping thread open for any procurement questions.
